verses.1: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David to bring to remembrance. Make haste , O God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O LORD.
verses.2: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.
verses.3: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.
verses.4: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
verses.5: But I am poor and needy: make haste to me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD, make no delay.

metadata.source: Derived from Webster's Bible (1833), revised as a poetic KJV-tradition translation filtered through the theology of abiding in Christ.
